name: morocco-professional-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Morocco personal income tax (Impot sur le Revenu, IR) on professional or business income under the real net result (RNR) or simplified net result (RNS) systems, for tax year 2026. Covers the Art. 73 scale, the Art. 74 family reduction, business income, deductible and non-deductible charges, the cotisation minimale, the annual revenu global return, deadlines and penalties. Trigger on phrases like "impot sur le revenu Maroc", "Morocco income tax", "IR professionnel", "resultat net reel", "resultat net simplifie", "RNR", "RNS", "bareme IR Maroc", "cotisation minimale", "declaration revenu global", "الضريبة على الدخل المغرب", "صافي الربح". Replies in the user's language (English, French, Moroccan Arabic or Darija).
